The '''Blood Pits''' of [[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]] were located in the [[Corellian Sector (Nar Shaddaa)/Legends|Corellian Sector]], and were where violent free-for-alls were staged. The [[Feeorin/Legends|Feeorin]] [[Nym/Legends|Nym]] fought in the Blood Pits with great success, once defeating a [[Trandoshan/Legends|Trandoshan]].
